summary: General Fusion Group Ltd., a Canadian foreign private issuer listed on NASDAQ (GFUZ), filed a Form 6-K furnishing two press releases dated October 8, 2026, announcing a scientific milestone rather than a transactional event. Its Lawson Machine 26 demonstration achieved electron temperatures exceeding 1 keV (roughly 12.6-13.7 million degrees Celsius) via Thomson scattering and AXUV diagnostics, with meaningful ion heating, measured jointly with the UK Atomic Energy Authority. No securities, ownership, pricing, or deal terms are implicated; the filing is a routine operational disclosure and poses no risk-arb angle.
